messages.content: "你能幫我計劃一次旅行嗎？我需要知道從紐約到倫敦的距離，使用 'geodistance.find' 函數計算出的公里數，然後我想知道紐約和倫敦之間的時差，使用 'timezones.get_difference' 函數。之後，我想要在 '下週五' 這個日期上尋找從紐約到倫敦的航班，使用 'flights.search' 函數。最後，我想再次使用 'geodistance.find' 函數，找出從倫敦到巴黎的距離，以英里為單位。"

function.name: flights_search
function.description: Find flights between two cities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date to fly. Default is today if not specified.

function.name: timezones_get_difference
function.description: Find the time difference between two cities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: geodistance_find
function.description: Find the distance between two cities on the globe. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

origin.description: The originating city for the distance calculation.

destination.description: The destination city for the distance calculation.

unit.description: The unit of measure for the distance calculation.
